name: Steven Schloss
bio:
Steven Schloss is recognized as a Boston certified artist known for his edgy high-concepts, surrealistic visual storytelling and heavy-metal tones.

In 2023 he set out to make his first narrative short, WRITER'S BLOCK after a decade of working strictly in the commercial space.

Shortly after its festival premiere the film entered distribution with Cineverse/Bloody Disgusting and is programmed on Screambox as part of their #1 hit original series, Bloody Bites.

As Steven continues to carve his path in the narrative world, it's clear he is drawn to stories that lend a heightened tone and believes that cinema should be fun, exotic and bend reality while delivering a high level of emotional intelligence.

credits.title: Fresh Meat
credits.overview: In the back of a butcher shop, a little girl watches terrifying tales on a screen that must be fed. As its appetite grows, her father must find increasingly gruesome ways to keep the show going.

credits.title: Vape Glow
credits.overview: Told entirely from the perspective of a recalled vape pen, Mike puffs around a dark vacation rental, illuminating it during an unusual blackout.

credits.title: Gimme
credits.overview: On the first night of Hanukkah, a grandfather and his estranged granddaughter are pulled into a sinister game of dreidel.

credits.title: And They Shall Handle Serpents
credits.overview: A deranged takeout delivery driver, hoping to lead the wayward home to the Father, makes a terrifying adjustment to their orders.

credits.title: How the Lonely Keep
credits.overview: Weeks after her disappearance, a local teen returns to the places she knew best, while an unseen hand holds the secret of why she may never be found.

credits.title: Katie’s Skin
credits.overview: Through a gruesome revelation, a woman learns to find comfort in her own skin.

credits.title: Writer's Block
credits.overview: The story follows a prisoner who is given all the tools necessary to complete his unconventional and bloody writing process. As he begins to write, he confronts his own mortality and comes to terms with the pain and chaos in his life.
